sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.22562 of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"to issue appropriate writ, order or direction, particularly writ of mandamus declaring the action of the Respondents in not awarding compensation for use and occupation (damages) for the period 03.05.2012 (date of possession) till 21.05.2022 in respect of land admeasuring Ac.27.35  guntas in the Survey Nos.301, 304, 315,
317, 327, 328, 331, 389, 391, 392, 432, 449, 451, 459, 461, 462, 473, 474, 478, 479 and 483 situated in Bollikunta Village of Khila Warangal Mandal forming part of Ward No.41, Greater Warangal Municipal Corporation limits, of Warangal District besides the non-grant of interest on the total sum of market value, 100% solatium and 12%
Addl. market value at 9% for the first year i.e., 21.05.2022 to 20.05.2023 and thereafter 15% p.a., from 21.05.2023 till the date of actual payment of award amount as illegal, arbitrary, violative of Articles 19, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India,
and the provisions The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Resettlement and Rehabilitation Act, 2013 and issue a consequential direction directing the Respondents herein to pay the amounts/compensation for use and occupation of land admeasuring Ac.27.35  guntas in Survey Nos. 301, 304, 315,
317, 327, 328, 331, 389, 391, 392, 432, 449, 451, 459, 461, 462, 473, 474, 478, 479 and 483 situated in Bollikunta Village of Khila Warangal Mandal forming part of Ward No.41, Greater Warangal Municipal Corporation limits, of Warangal District within such time as may be fixed by this Hon'ble Court proportionately to each of the Petitioners herein to the extent of land lost (vide annexure annexed to the affidavit)
and pass such further order or orders as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."

2. The case of the petitioners is that they are the absolute owners and possessors of various extents of the lands in various survey numbers situated in Bollikunta Village of Khila Warangal Mandal forming part of Ward No.41, Greater Warangal Municipal Corporation Limits of Warangal District.

It is the case of the petitioners that said land was acquired by the CVBR, J wp_22562_2023 respondents without following the procedure contemplated under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and an award under Section 6 of the Act was passed vide Award No.96/2008-2009 dated 04.12.2008.
Challenging the said award, the petitioners filed W.P.No.26777 of 2011 seeking restoration of the possession of the said lands.

This Court vide its order dated 21.06.2016 allowed the said writ petition and set aside the notification issued under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and consequential award passed under Section 6 of the Act vide award No.96/2008-2009, dated 04.12.2008, and directed the respondents therein to restore the possession of the subject lands to the petitioners.

It is stated that aggrieved by the said Keerthi Laxmi vs State Of Telangana on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35577977/
1 orders, the State has filed Writ Appeal No.1140 of 2016 and the Division Bench of this Court vide its order dated 22.12.2021 disposed of the writ appeal directing the State to initiate fresh land acquisition proceedings.

3. Sri J.Prabhakar, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are entitled to damages i.e., additional interest @ 15% per annum on the amount of compensation awarded under the provisions of the Act, 2013 from the date of taking possession i.e.
03.05.2012, to till the date of publication of preliminary notification dated 21.05.2022 issued under Section 11(1) of the Act, 2013 and also interest @ 9% per annum for the first year on the total compensation amount i.e. from 21.05.2022 to 20.05.2023 and thereafter, at the rate of 15% interest per annum for the subsequent period from 21.05.2023 till the date of actual payment of the entire compensation amount is paid to the petitioners and relied upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Balwan Singh and others v. Land Acquisition Collector and another 1.
4.

sentences.text:
5. The only grievance of the petitioners is that the respondents having taken possession of the lands from them on 03.05.2012 have not paid any additional interest by way of damages at 15% per annum from the date of taking possession and also interest at the rate of 9% per annum after determining the compensation amount payable to them from 21.05.2022 to 20.05.2023.
6.

In Balwan Singh and others v. Land Acquisition Collector and another (1 supra) the Hon'ble Apex Court by following the judgment of Tahera Khotoon v. Land Acquistion Officer 2 has directed the respondents therein to award additional interest by way of damages @15% p.a. for the period between 01.07.1984, the date when the appellants were dispossessed till 02.09.1993, the date of notification under Section 4(1) of the Act.

sentences.text: It was also observed that the (2014) 13 SCC 613 CVBR, J wp_22562_2023 compensation will be on the basis of the land value fixed by the Reference Court.

7. Admittedly, the respondents have taken possession of the land of the petitioners on 03.05.2012 and the preliminary notification has been issued on 21.05.2022 under the Provisions of the Act,
2013.

In view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in Balwan Singh's case (supra) and since the occupation of the land of the petitioners was taken by the respondents illegally, without issuing any notification, the petitioners are entitled to the additional interest at 15% per annum on the compensation as determined by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Balwan Singh's case (supra) from the date of taking possession till the date of issuance of the notification under Section 11(1) of the Act,
2013.

The petitioners are also entitled to interest @ 9% per annum for the first year on the total compensation i.e. from 21.05.2022 to 20.05.2023 till the date of passing of award and thereafter,
Keerthi Laxmi vs State Of Telangana on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35577977/
2 interest @ 15% per annum for the subsequent period till the date of actual payment has been made or deposited.

sentences.text:
The respondents are directed to complete the aforesaid exercise as expeditiously as CVBR, J wp_22562_2023 possible, preferably, within a period of four(4) months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
8.
With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
9. As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
